text:
Maria G.: Heads-up — Datadog reached out asking to sync on an observability joint announcement: they want to highlight our OpenTelemetry + tracing work and partner dashboards in their marketplace. Wanted to see who can join a quick sync this week. :eyes:

Ravi K.: +1 we should confirm which traces/signals we'll surface (latency, batch sizes, cache hit rate). Datadog will want sample dashboards and an ingest example.

Alex P.: I can pull a candidate dashboard from eng-sre metrics. We already emit OTLP traces and a subset of the proxy metrics. Need to know which pipeline (agent vs OTLP ingest) we recommend for customers.

Sam T.: Marketing wants the storyline: production-ready, low-latency inference, and turnkey dashboard templates. Jen — can we ship a joint blog + marketplace tile?

Jen L.: Yep, we can do a co-announcement. Need logos, joint one-liner, and an 800-word blog draft. Also timeline: if eng can freeze artifacts by Fri next week we can target the following Wed for publish.

Maria G.: Proposed agenda for the sync: 1) integration surface (agent/OTLP/Direct API) 2) telemetry schema (traces, spans, attributes) 3) dashboard + monitor examples 4) marketplace tile content & imagery 5) timelines + approvals. Who's available Thu 10am PT?

Ravi K.: Thu 10am PT works for me. I'll prepare a short write-up on attributes we already emit and a sample curl to send traces.

Alex P.: I'll bring a draft dashboard JSON and a runbook for customers (how to enable auto-instrumentation).

Sam T.: I'll RSVP Thu and invite Datadog PMs. Also can we include a short partner checklist for legal + security? (SLA, data sharing, logos)

Maria G.: Yes please. Datadog asked about data-retention language and whether traces include customer PII — we'll need a clear statement for the marketplace tile. Ravi, can you confirm current obfuscation rules?

Ravi K.: Traces currently scrub request body and obfuscate token headers. We do include model_id, model_version, latency_ms, batch_size, cache_hit boolean, and route. No user-text is stored in traces. I'll add a short privacy blurb.

datadog-bot: Docs link: https://www.datadoghq.com/integrations/opentelemetry/ — marketplace guidelines: https://www.datadoghq.com/marketplace/partners

Jen L.: Perfect. After sync we should aim for: 1) draft blog + partner quote 2) dashboard JSON + import instructions 3) marketplace tile assets (logos + short description). I can assemble the PR for the blog.

Alex P.: Quick note on implementation — sample OTLP env for customers (we can include in docs):
```
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://ingest.redwood.ai/v1/traces
export OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=redwood-inference
```
Will also add example for using Datadog agent forwarding.

Maria G.: Great. I'll book Thu 10am PT and add the Datadog PMs. Thanks all — please drop any pre-reads in the meeting thread. :thumbsup:
